objective: Test whether the same 8.19 footage becomes materially more selectable when Information leads and Emotion supports, without treating transitions as the main variable.
reference_use: The accepted 17.533 s reference body supplies structural and pacing principles only; no wording or imagery is copied.
director_rules: Open on a readable question and recognizable product use, not the full box-opening action.
Every segment must add a new question, action, quantity, mechanism, supported benefit, or sales fact.
Cut when the current information is readable and exhausted.
Use approximately 1.5-2.2 s per main information state unless readability or a complete action requires more.
Use a short number-to-question flip as mechanism proof.
Use multi-card layout as breadth evidence and the complete product view as Hero plus CTA.
If distinct readable states are insufficient, shorten the edit and record the material ceiling.
forbidden: repeated question or repeated action presented as new information
machine declaration of Human Preference PASS
